fareRule.text:
THE FARE COMPONENT MUST BE ON
ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWING
ANY EN FLIGHT
ANY EW FLIGHT
ANY LH FLIGHT
ANY LX FLIGHT
ANY OS FLIGHT
ANY SN FLIGHT.
fareRule.title: FLIGHT APPLICATION

fareRule.text:
CONFIRMED RESERVATIONS ARE REQUIRED FOR ALL SECTORS.
WHEN RESERVATIONS ARE MADE AT LEAST 24 HOURS BEFORE
DEPARTURE, TICKETING MUST BE COMPLETED WITHIN 24 HOURS
AFTER RESERVATIONS ARE MADE.
OR - CONFIRMED RESERVATIONS FOR ALL SECTORS AND
TICKETING MUST BE COMPLETED AT THE SAME TIME.
fareRule.title: ADVANCE RESERVATIONS/TICKETING

fareRule.text: STOPOVERS ARE NOT PERMITTED AT INTERMEDIATE POINTS.
fareRule.title: STOPOVERS

fareRule.text:
1 TRANSFERS PERMITTED IN EACH DIRECTION.

ON THE FARE COMPONENT.
NOTE - TEXT BELOW NOT VALIDATED FOR AUTOPRICING.

fareRule.text:
DOUBLE OPEN JAWS NOT PERMITTED.
END-ON-END NOT PERMITTED. SIDE TRIPS PERMITTED WITH
NO RESTRICTIONS.
OPEN JAWS/ROUND TRIPS/CIRCLE TRIPS

-TO FORM SINGLE OPEN JAWS
A MAXIMUM OF TWO INTERNATIONAL FARE COMPONENTS
PERMITTED. MILEAGE OF THE OPEN SEGMENT MUST BE EQUAL/
LESS THAN MILEAGE OF THE LONGEST FLOWN FARE
COMPONENT.
-TO FORM ROUND TRIPS
-TO FORM CIRCLE TRIPS
A MAXIMUM OF TWO INTERNATIONAL FARE COMPONENTS
PERMITTED.
PROVIDED -
COMBINATIONS ARE WITH ANY FARE FOR CARRIER EW/EN/
LH/LX/OS/SN IN ANY RULE IN TARIFF
IPREURP - WITHIN EUROPE-INTERNATIONAL.
fareRule.title: COMBINATIONS

fareRule.text:
CANCELLATIONS
ANY TIME
TICKET IS NON-REFUNDABLE.
WAIVED FOR DEATH OF PASSENGER OR FAMILY MEMBER.
NOTE - TEXT BELOW NOT VALIDATED FOR AUTOPRICING.
WAIVERS MUST BE EVIDENCED BY DEATH CERTIFICATE.
----
THE FOLLOWING RULES APPLY PER FARE COMPONENT.
----
WHEN COMBINING NON-REFUNDABLE FARES WITH
REFUNDABLE FARES
1. THE AMOUNT PAID ON EACH REFUNDABLE FARE
COMPONENT IS REFUNDED.
2. THE AMOUNT PAID ON EACH NON-REFUNDABLE FARE
COMPONENT WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
3. WHEN COMBINING FARES CHARGE THE SUM OF THE
CANCELLATION FEES OF ALL CANCELLED FARE
COMPONENTS.
----
FULL REFUND PERMITTED BEFORE DEPARTURE IN CASE OF
REJECTION OF VISA. EMBASSY STATEMENT REQUIRED.
----
REFUND OF UNUSED FEES AND TAXES PERMITTED.
REFUND OF UNUSED YQ NOT PERMITTED.
REFUND OF UNUSED YR SURCHARGES OF CARRIERS OTHER
THAN LH/LX/OS/SN PERMITTED.
LH/LX/OS/SN DCC - DISTRIBUTION COST CHARGE - /AD
INTERIM SHOWN AS YR ON THE TICKET/ WILL NOT BE
REFUNDED.
UNLESS APPLICABLE OW/RT FARE PLUS TAXES FOR
ACTUAL TRAVEL IS HIGHER THAN WHOLE ORIGINAL
TICKET. IN THIS CASE NO TAX OR FEE REFUND WILL BE
PERMITTED.
EXCEPTION-
THE TICKET PURCHASER IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR A REFUND
OF THE PASSENGER FACILITY CHARGE TAX ON UNUSED/
NONREFUNDABLE OR EXPIRED TICKETS
----
THE OPTIONAL PAYMENT CHARGE WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
CHANGES
BEFORE DEPARTURE
CHANGES PERMITTED.
NOTE - TEXT BELOW NOT VALIDATED FOR AUTOPRICING.
WAIVERS MUST BE EVIDENCED BY DEATH CERTIFICATE.
--------
THE FOLLOWING RULES APPLY PER FARE COMPONENT
/DIRECTION.
--------
IN CASE OF FARE COMBINATION
CHARGE THE HIGHEST FEE OF CHANGED FARE COMPONENTS.
--------
CHILD DISCOUNT DOES NOT APPLY.
INFANT WITHOUT SEAT FREE OF CHARGE.
--------
CHANGES NOT PERMITTED IN CASE OF NO SHOW.
PLS REFER TO REFUND SECTION IF APPLICABLE.
--------
CHANGES PERMITTED FOR REROUTING/REBOOKING
PROVIDED THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS ARE COMPLIED
WITH-
REROUTING PERMITTED.
REROUTING/REBOOKING PERMITTED PROVIDED ALL
CONDITIONS OF THE NEW FARE INCLUDING ADVANCE
PURCHASE ARE COMPLIED WITH IRRESPECTIVE IF CHANGE
OCCURS TO OUTBOUND OR INBOUND FLIGHT.
WHEN THE NEW ITINERARY RESULTS IN A HIGHER FARE
THE DIFFERENCE WILL BE COLLECTED - AND - THE
CHANGE FEE WILL BE APPLIED.
WHEN THE NEW ITINERARY RESULTS IN A LOWER FARE THE
CHANGE FEE WILL BE APPLIED - AND - NO CREDIT OF
THE RESIDUAL AMOUNT WILL BE MADE.
--------
REBOOKING/REROUTING MUST BE FINALIZED BEFORE
DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINAL FLIGHT BEING CHANGED
PROVIDED ALL CONDITIONS INCLUDING ADVANCE
PURCHASE ARE COMPLIED WITH.
IF NOT DONE BEFORE ORIGINAL FLIGHT BEING CHANGED
TICKET WILL ONLY BE VALID FOR REFUND OR NOT
APPLICABLE AT ALL.
REISSUE/MCO ISSUANCE MUST BE MADE WITHIN 24 HOURS
AFTER CHANGE OF RESERVATION BUT NOT LATER THAN
DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINAL FLIGHT BEING CHANGED.
IF NOT DONE WITHIN 24 HOURS AFTER CHANGE OF
RESERVATION AND BEFORE DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINAL
FLIGHT BEING CHANGED TICKET WILL ONLY BE VALID
FOR REFUND OR NOT APPLICABLE AT ALL.
--------
THE ORIGINAL NON-REFUNDABLE AMOUNT REMAINS NON-
REFUNDABLE.
--------
COMPLETELY UNUSED TICKETS CANNOT BE CHANGED INTO
A TICKET WHERE ORIGINAL ISSUING CARRIER IS NO
LONGER INCLUDED IN THE ITINERARY. TICKET IS THEN
ONLY BE VALID FOR REFUND. PLS REFER TO REFUND
SECTION IF APPLICABLE.
--------
FOR CARRIER EW ONLY WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE AND THE
ORIGINALLY TICKETED
BOOKING CLASS ARE KEPT THE NEW FARE MAY BE LOWER-
EQUAL OR HIGHER.
IN ALL OTHER CASES THE NEW FARE MAY ONLY BE EQUAL
OR HIGHER.
FOR CARRIERS LH/LX/OS/4Y/SN/EN REISSUE ONLY
PERMITTED INTO -CLS/-BUZ/-NC/-RC/-RF/-RN/-FF FARE
FAMILY. FOR OTHER CARRIERS THERE IS NO FARE TYPE
RESTRICTION.
